# ratel-decompose-prompt-video-editor

Break a bloated, monolithic agent system prompt into a lean stable core plus extracted Ratel-style skills. Use when a prompt is too long or does too many things, to extract or factor procedures into skills, decompose or split a prompt, cut per-turn token cost, or `/ratel-decompose-prompt`. Writes a markdown decomposition plan (lean core, skill inventory, per-skill SKILL definitions, registration wiring) to repo/.ratel/ without rewriting the prompt or code. Reached from /ratel-assessment's Prompt Decomposition dimension; pairs with /ratel-tune-definitions.\n

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$ratel-decompose-prompt-video-editor`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
